title: 第三十章 深夜进山，诡异循环的亡魂
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
清了清嗓子，姜无念扬声说：“等天黑我还会进山一趟，这活我既然接了，就一定会给你们解决，否则我绝不下山！”

    自知理亏，李康顺见势赶忙出来打圆场：

    “各位，人确实是我请来的，既然大师都这么说了，咱们就再耐心等几天吧，大过年的，别闹得太难看，让人家笑话。”

    众人见李康顺都站出来说话了，知道没热闹看了，只能兴致缺缺地散了去。

    一出李家院门，姜无念的脸马上垮了下来，气鼓鼓地踢着路上的小石子，腮帮子微微鼓着，与之前侃侃而谈的模样判若两人。

    “气死我了！一群不识好人心的家伙！”她边走边嘟囔，脚步不自觉快了起来，“早知道这么麻烦，我才不接这破活！”

    跟在她身边，傅烬川看着她气呼呼的模样，有些不解，“他们这么对你，为什么还要帮？”

    像这种样子的刁民，最是不讲理。

    修道者本该随心所欲，从不同情心泛滥，怎会因这些人绊住手脚。

    姜无念回头白了他一眼，“为师不是和你说了吗？因果缠身，推不掉的！再说了……”

    想着刚才的话，狠狠锤了他一下：“你个败家玩意儿！我可不愿意三倍赔偿！”

    傅烬川更不理解了，既然这件事情这么麻烦，为什么还要继续去做，毕竟能用钱解决的都不叫事。

    他以为姜无念是不想花这个钱，轻咳一声：“我不在乎赔偿。”

    “我在乎！”姜无念仰起头，“那可是钱！能买朱砂黄纸，能买好多好吃的……能……”

    “我可以给你。”

    “给我干嘛？你赚钱很容易吗？”

    “很容易。”

    “……？那没事了。”

    两人一路拌嘴。

    等到天黑背着补给再次进山，入夜以后的山林更是阴森，草木晃动，风声不断呜咽。

    傅烬川习惯性掏出打火机，刚打着火，马上就灭了，连打三次都是一样的结果。

    姜无念实在忍不住吐槽他：“你以为过了几天就能打着了？还不信啊？”
content_en:
Clearing his throat, Jiang Wu Nian raised his voice and said, "I will go into the mountain when it gets dark. Since I have accepted this job, I will definitely solve it for you, otherwise I will never go down the mountain!"

    Knowing that he was in the wrong, Li Kangshun saw the situation and hurriedly came out to smooth things over:

    "Everyone, I did invite this person. Since everyone has said so, let's just wait patiently for a few more days. It's Chinese New Year, so don't make it too ugly and make people laugh."

    When everyone saw Li Kangshun standing up to speak, they knew there was no excitement and could only disperse without interest.

    As soon as he walked out of the gate of Li's courtyard, Jiang Wu Nian's face immediately fell. He kicked the pebbles on the road angrily, his cheeks bulging slightly, and he looked completely different from the person he had been chatting with before.

    "I'm so angry! A bunch of guys who don't know good people's hearts!" She muttered as she walked, her steps unconsciously picking up speed. "If I had known it was so troublesome, I wouldn't have taken this crappy job!"

    Following her, Fu Jinchuan looked at her angry look and was a little puzzled, "They treat you like this, why do you still want to help?"

    Tricky people like this are the most unreasonable.

    Ascetics are supposed to follow their own whims and never have too much compassion, so how can they be held back by these people?

    Jiang Wunian turned around and rolled his eyes at him, "Didn't I tell you, my master? You are entangled in cause and effect, and you can't push it away! Besides..."

    Thinking about what I just said, I gave him a hard blow: "You loser! I am not willing to pay triple compensation!"

    Fu Jinchuan couldn't understand even more. If this matter is so troublesome, why should he continue to do it? After all, it's not a big deal if it can be solved with money.

    He thought Jiang Wunian didn't want to spend the money, so he coughed lightly: "I don't care about compensation."

    "I care!" Jiang Wunian raised his head, "That's money! I can buy cinnabar yellow paper, I can buy a lot of delicious food... I can..."

    "I can give it to you."

    "What are you doing for me? Is it easy for you to make money?"

    "It's easy."

    "...? Then it's okay."

    The two quarreled all the way.

    When it gets dark, I carry supplies on my back and head into the mountains again. After dark, the forest becomes even more eerie, with the vegetation swaying and the wind constantly moaning.

    Fu Jinchuan habitually took out his lighter, and as soon as it lit the fire, it was extinguished immediately. He tried it three times in a row with the same result.

    Jiang Wu Nian couldn't help but complain to him: "Do you think you'll be able to fight in a few days? You still don't believe it?"
title_en: Chapter 30: Going into the mountains late at night, the strange cycle of dead souls
